definitions.explanation: A public event or showing to announce and display a completed work, building, or product. Most commonly used for film premieres and building completion ceremonies.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}の{完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}{試写会|ししゃかい}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: A premiere screening of the film was held.

examples.japanese: {新|しん}ビルの{完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}パーティーに{招待|しょうたい}された。
examples.english: I was invited to the completion unveiling party for the new building.

examples.japanese: {監督|かんとく}と{主演|しゅえん}{俳優|はいゆう}が{完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}{舞台挨拶|ぶたいあいさつ}に{登壇|とうだん}した。
examples.english: The director and lead actor appeared at the premiere stage greeting.

notes:
A compound of {完成|かんせい} (completion) and {披露|ひろう} (public announcement; unveiling). Most frequently used in the entertainment industry for film and drama premieres.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}{試写会|ししゃかい}: premiere screening
- {完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}{上映|じょうえい}: premiere showing
- {完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}{舞台挨拶|ぶたいあいさつ}: premiere stage greeting
- {完成|かんせい}{披露|ひろう}{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}: premiere press conference

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {初公開|はつこうかい}: first public showing — more general, used for any type of first reveal
- お{披露目|ひろめ}: debut; unveiling — broader, used for introducing people, products, and events
- プレミア{上映|じょうえい}: premiere screening (loanword) — the film industry loanword alternative
